Links of every kind

This page links out in several ways so the extractor can show which links it keeps and which become text.

Run the demo is a script link and must stay plain text.

The plain report uses plain http and keeps its link too.

The secure report keeps its https link.

The guide has no scheme of its own and follows the page's.

Omar's page is relative to this one, and back to top stays here.

A data link and a mail link are text.

An odd address gets its spaces and brackets encoded.
